label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.13: Whatever both moves and is moved moves as an…
locator: I.13 [15]: all movers will be as instrumental causes, because they will be moved movers
interpretation: In the third proof against an infinite series, every mover in the series counts as an instrumental cause for the reason that it is a moved mover. Read as: being a moved mover suffices for moving as an instrument rather than as a principal mover. The text does not consider a mover moved only in a respect irrelevant to its moving, so it bears on, but does not settle, the strong per se reading of ST I q.2 a.3. Basis: the English translation named in the passage manifest; a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness exists, and never a ground for overriding a reading of the Leonine/SCTA Latin.
